call_input.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: one finished portrait 2:3 flat poster.
Input image: the supplied repair-1 G02 poster is the sole edit target.

Perform the final typography refinement of this existing poster. Keep the botanical image in its current exact composition: the shared curved branch ascending from lower left to upper right, the closed bud, cupped partly open flower and fully open fan, their same locations and scale, the leaves and branching joints, the veins, the petal curl directions, the upper/right flower crop, cream petal faces, jade-blue undersides, midnight blue-green ground and matte print illustration surface. Preserve plant structure and its three visible stages. Do not shift, enlarge or redraw the flowers to accommodate the lettering.

Replace only the current low horizontal title line. Cleanly restore the former text area with the same unmarked dark printed ground. Redesign the title as one continuous, gently rising sentence that occupies the negative space immediately beneath the ascending branch. The sentence should visually share the branch's upward unfolding, rather than sitting as an independent straight strip at the bottom.

Make a single cohesive readable text path, in normal left-to-right word order, beginning below the left bud/branch interval around x=17%, y=77% and finishing beneath the open bloom around x=89%, y=67%. These percentages describe the approximate baseline endpoints, not printed guides. Use a very shallow smooth upward arc, with a restrained overall rise of about one character height across the complete phrase. Keep the three words close enough to be perceived as ONE sentence, with only its two clear normal word spaces. The baseline rises continuously; do not place the words on three detached horizontal stairs. Slightly rotate intact character blocks with the local arc, as real typesetting following a curve; do not stretch, skew, melt, distort or replace any Korean strokes. Keep all six syllables the same optical height and coherent weight. Make the left beginning as visually strong as the right ending so the eye enters at the first word rather than jumping to the last. Use the source's large solid warm bone-white plain Korean Gothic treatment, with normal compact spacing between syllables. Size the complete title for direct thumbnail reading. No oversize final word and no independent word-size hierarchy.

The sentence's gently unfolding word intervals and continuous baseline should respond to the plant's widening open forms. Give every character a clear dark gap from stems, leaves and petals; keep the entire plant uncovered. The title should feel optically joined to the growth movement through its scale, proximity, path and rhythm, with a generous quiet lower margin beneath it. Do not add an underline, connecting line, arrow, decorative shape or new effect to manufacture the connection. Preserve every other part of the source.

Text (verbatim, sole permitted visible copy, exactly once): 밤에 피는 정원
Preserve the six complete Hangul syllables and two clearly visible original word spaces. No quotation marks, punctuation, other text, captions, numbers, stage labels, Latin letters, metadata, logo, signature, watermark, symbol, ornament or added effects.

요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력. Maintain the source portrait 2:3 ratio and return exactly one flat poster.

nontext_upper_region_pixel_difference.note: Nonzero difference confirms nontext detail was also regenerated.
